hero.lede: I'm David — an independent designer and developer building considered websites and brand systems for founders, studios and the occasional museum.

intro.body: I work end-to-end — strategy, identity, art direction, design, and the code that ships. No handoffs, no slide decks pretending to be products. Just a small number of careful engagements a year, made with the founders who'll live with them.

projects.desc: A reserved identity and editorial site for a thesis-driven investment firm.
Visual system and site for an architectural practice in Athens.
A scrollable exhibition for the museum's spring archive opening.
Editorial commerce for a small-batch homeware brand.
Repositioning and website for a logistics platform raising Series B.
From wordmark to wayfinding for a coastal hospitality group.

about.title: About
paragraphs: I'm a designer based in Tel Aviv. For the last eight years I've worked independently with founders, studios and small institutions to make their digital presence quieter, sharper and a little more permanent-feeling.

Before going independent I was design lead at a product studio and, briefly, at an architectural office. The shift between the two — fast software, slow architecture — is still the most useful tension in how I work.
Outside of client work I write occasionally, run a small typography journal, and keep a playground of experiments that don't fit anywhere else.

items.d: Wordmarks, visual systems, guidelines. The quiet kind, made to last.
Editorial sites, marketing, portfolios. Always considered, never templated.
React, Next.js, Webflow. I build what I design — no handoffs.
Direction for shoots, illustration, motion and the things between.

steps.d: A first call to understand what you're really building and whether I'm right for it.
A short written proposal: scope, schedule, budget. No decks.
A week of listening, reading, sketching. We agree on the story before any pixels.
Considered explorations in the open. You see real prototypes, not concept slides.
I build what I design — clean code, no surprises at handoff.
Launch, then a month of attentive aftercare. I stay close.

items.quote: David is rare — a designer who actually ships the thing he draws, and ships it better than anyone we briefed before. He treats your business like it's his.
items.author: Mira Halevy

items.quote: He folded into our team for six months and made everything around him quieter and more confident. The work is genuinely beautiful.
items.author: Petros Vasiliou

items.quote: I've worked with three studios in Tel Aviv. David is the only one who gave me the unglamorous answers I needed — and then designed something better than the glamorous ones promised.
items.author: Yael Ronen
